text:
For a **plug-in backup**, I’d look at the **[BLUETTI Elite 200 V2](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2)**. Its 2,073.6 Wh capacity is estimated to run a 100 W ceramic heat emitter for about a day when a thermostat cycles it on roughly half the time. A lower-wattage heat mat should last longer, though actual runtime depends on how often the heater runs. [Source and estimate](https://dealectric.com/power-station-to-keep-reptile-heat-on-in-a-power-outage)

Before buying, check your heater’s wattage and make sure the station can supply it. For a longer outage, **insulate the enclosure first** to conserve heat, and keep the thermostat in use. [Petco outage guidance](https://www.petco.com/pet-education/reptile/general/caring-for-your-pet-reptiles-during-a-power-outage)
